title: Humming
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, quiet suburban house at night, soft green electronic glow and cold moonlight, muted grey-blue palette with warm lamp accents, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. The baby monitor picked up a woman humming. The nursery was empty. 📻

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: At 2:10 in the morning, the baby monitor picked up a woman humming. The nursery was empty.
scenes.image: a baby monitor receiver glowing soft green on a nightstand in a dark bedroom, its sound lights lit

scenes.narration: Dana and Eli Moss had a three-week-old son and an old house they bought for the yard. That night he was fussy, so he slept between them.
scenes.image: an old two-story suburban house at night under a full moon, one upstairs window faintly lit

scenes.narration: The monitor stayed on the nightstand anyway, pointed at an empty crib down the hall. Habit. Little green lights in the dark.
scenes.image: close-up of a small monitor receiver on a wooden nightstand, tiny green lights in total darkness

scenes.narration: Then the lights jumped. Sound. Dana sat up. Through the speaker came a woman's voice, humming. Low. Sweet. Very close to the microphone.
scenes.image: a woman sitting up in bed in the dark, staring at a glowing monitor, moonlight on her face

scenes.narration: Eli ran down the hall. The nursery was empty. Crib empty. Window shut. The camera on the shelf, staring at nothing.
scenes.image: an empty nursery at night, an empty crib in moonlight, a small camera on a shelf facing the room

scenes.narration: He came back. The monitor was still humming. And now, under the humming, something else. A slow wooden creak. Forward. Back. Forward.
scenes.image: a man standing in a dark bedroom doorway, listening, the green glow of the monitor on his face

scenes.narration: Dana knew that sound. Everybody knows that sound. A rocking chair.
scenes.image: an old wooden rocking chair silhouetted against a moonlit window, slightly blurred mid-rock

scenes.narration: Eli checked every room. The closets. The garage. Nothing. They don't own a rocking chair. They never have.
scenes.image: a man with a flashlight searching a dark cluttered garage, cardboard boxes and old furniture covers

scenes.narration: At three, the humming stopped. Mid-note. Like someone had heard them talking.
scenes.image: the baby monitor on the nightstand with every light suddenly dark, the couple's shadows behind it

scenes.narration: Then a woman's voice whispered through the speaker, close and calm. Shh. They're listening.
scenes.image: extreme close-up of a small speaker grille glowing green in the dark, the room behind it black
